description: This file contains the definition of the SubscriptionPlan class, which manages database operations related to subscription plans in an OpenCart module. It includes methods to retrieve individual plans, lists of plans with filtering and sorting, and the total count of plans.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: A model class for fetching subscription plan data from the database, extending the core Opencart Engine Model class.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a single subscription plan record by ID, joining the main and description tables.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription plans with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscription plan records in the database.
